trace.question: Please state the finishing rate and curve score of the player who has the heaviest weight.
trace.evidence: finishing rate refer to finishing; curve score refer to curve; heaviest weight refers to MAX(weight)

attempts.sql:
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.weight DESC
LIMIT 1

verdicts.text:
The query returns every attribute record (38 rows) for the heaviest player, but the question asks for one player's finishing and curve values. It needs to return a single row.

```sql
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.weight DESC
LIMIT 1
```

trace.final_sql:
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.weight DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The player with the heaviest weight has a finishing rate of 13 and a curve score of 13.
